claim.quote: With this measurement, the world data on strange contributions to nucleon form factors are seen to be consistent with zero and not more than a few percent of the proton form factors.

name: HAPPEX-III: strange vector form factors of the proton at Q^2 = 0.624 GeV^2

summary.plain: HAPPEX-III repeated the measurement at a higher momentum transfer, where an earlier experiment had hinted at a strange-quark effect. It found none: the contribution is consistent with zero, and with all other data at most a few percent of the proton's form factors.
summary.technical: A_PV = -23.80 +- 0.78 stat +- 0.36 syst ppm at Q^2 = 0.624 GeV^2 and beam energy 3.48 GeV, giving G_E^s + 0.517 G_M^s = 0.003 +- 0.010 stat +- 0.004 syst +- 0.009 ff; the world data on strange form factors are consistent with zero.

title: New Precision Limit on the Strange Vector Form Factors of the Proton
why_it_matters: Closed the question left open by earlier hints of a strange-quark effect at higher momentum transfer.
